_meta.description: Verified chemical data for 16 inventory materials missing ODT coverage
_meta.notes: VP values in Pa at 25C unless stated. ODT in ppb (air) and ppm (ethanol). MW from PubChem.

beta-pinene.logp_note: PubChem XLogP=3.1 is authoritative. Codebase value 4.2 is wrong.
beta-pinene.vp_note: Perplexity reports 2.4 mmHg = 320 Pa. Codebase has 300 (ingredient_intelligence) and 390 (B.yaml). Use 320 Pa.
beta-pinene.odt_note: B.yaml has 25 ppb (air). odor_thresholds.py has 8 ppb (air). Literature range 0.033-0.14 ppm in solution. Use 25 ppb air, 0.08 ppm ethanol.
beta-pinene.odor_profile: Dry woody, fresh, pine, resinous, terpenic. Highly volatile top note.
beta-pinene.allergen_note: EU allergen - declare if >0.001% in leave-on products

cinnamyl-alcohol.vp_note: Perplexity: <0.01 mmHg. Codebase has 0.03 Pa. Use 1.33 Pa (0.01 mmHg).
cinnamyl-alcohol.odt_note: Perplexity confirms 0.081 ppm (cis isomer). Trans isomer is 2.8 ppm. Codebase value 0.081 is for cis form.
cinnamyl-alcohol.odor_profile: Sweet balsamic, hyacinth, spicy, warm floral. Crystalline solid at RT.
cinnamyl-alcohol.ifra_note: IFRA 49th Amendment. Supplied as 50% in DPG for pourability.

cyclimal-aldehyde.vp_note: Perplexity: 0.0039 mmHg at 20C = 0.52 Pa. Codebase has no VP data.
cyclimal-aldehyde.odt_note: Perplexity: ~0.0025 ppm (2.5 ng/L). Codebase: 0.1 ppb air, 0.0025 ppm ethanol. Confirmed.
cyclimal-aldehyde.odor_profile: Floral fresh muguet, green, lily of the valley. Synthetic aromatic aldehyde.
cyclimal-aldehyde.note: NOT the same as Florol. ingredient_intelligence.py incorrectly aliases this to Florol.

dbca.mw_note: PubChem MW=192.25. Codebase has 204.27 (ingredient_intelligence) and 172.0 (molecular_weight_distribution). BOTH WRONG. Use 192.25.
dbca.vp_note: Codebase consistent at 0.8 Pa across files. Confirmed.
dbca.odt_note: Codebase value. No contradicting source found.
dbca.odor_profile: Gardenia-rose, cosmetic, sweet floral. Excellent diffusion.

lemon-fcf-oil-sicilian.mw_note: Use limonene MW as representative. Natural oil, variable composition.
lemon-fcf-oil-sicilian.vp_note: Limonene VP at 25C. Natural oil is a mixture.
lemon-fcf-oil-sicilian.odt_note: Use D-limonene ODT as representative. FCF = furocoumarin-free (phototoxin-removed).
lemon-fcf-oil-sicilian.odor_profile: Fresh bright lemon citrus, clean, tart. FCF version is phototoxin-free.

lilial.vp_note: Codebase: 0.01 Pa (ingredient_intelligence). Literature suggests higher. Use 0.33 Pa.
lilial.odt_note: Estimated from similar muguet aldehydes. No codebase ODT data exists.
lilial.odor_profile: Lily of the valley, fresh green floral, watery. IFRA-BANNED.
lilial.ifra_note: IFRA 49th Amendment - PROHIBITED in fine fragrance. Banned due to reproductive toxicity (CMR Cat 1B). Remove from formulation pipeline.

oranger-crystals.logp_note: PubChem XLogP=3.2. Codebase 2.8 is wrong. YAML has 2.678. Use 3.2.
oranger-crystals.vp_note: Perplexity: ~0.000611 mmHg = 0.08 Pa. YAML has 0.12 Pa. Codebase has 0.01 Pa. Use 0.08 Pa.
oranger-crystals.odt_note: Codebase: 250 ppb air, 1.0 ppm ethanol. Perplexity estimates 0.1-1.0 ppm. Confirmed.
oranger-crystals.odor_profile: Honeyed orange blossom, neroli, sweet dense floral. Crystalline solid.
oranger-crystals.ifra_note: Phototoxicity restriction. Crystalline solid - dilute to 10% w/v in DPG.

oud-fleuressence.mw_note: Estimated. This is a pre-blended fragrance oil designed to replicate oud character.
oud-fleuressence.vp_note: Estimated from ingredient_intelligence. No authoritative source available.
oud-fleuressence.odt_note: Estimated from oud oil literature values. True ODT depends on blend composition.
oud-fleuressence.odor_profile: Woody smoky animalic, barnyard, warm spicy. Synthetic oud reconstruction.
oud-fleuressence.note: Proprietary blend. MW/VP/logP are representative estimates only. No structured chemical identity data exists.

pedmc.odt_note: Codebase: 3.0 ppb air, 0.8 ppm ethanol. Confirmed.
pedmc.odor_profile: Rose-magnolia, clean, iris-rose harmonic, soft floral.

pine-eo.mw_note: Use pinene MW. P.yaml has 136.2 (correct for pinene). ingredient_intelligence has 170.0 (wrong - too high).
pine-eo.vp_note: P.yaml: 180 Pa. ingredient_intelligence: 2.0 Pa. P.yaml value is more consistent with pinene VP. Use 180 Pa.
pine-eo.odt_note: P.yaml: 25 ppb air. No ethanol ODT in codebase. Use 5 ppm ethanol (estimated from pinene literature).
pine-eo.odor_profile: Coniferous pine needle, fresh forest, terpene-rich, aromatic.
pine-eo.allergen_note: Contains alpha/beta-pinene, limonene, delta-3-carene. EU allergen declaration required.
pine-eo.oxidation_note: Terpene-rich - autoxidizes rapidly. Store sealed, cool, dark. Add BHT if >5% of formula.

polysantol.mw_note: Codebase: 222.37. PubChem lookup failed (trade name). CAS 68845-06-7 is the correct reference. MW 222.37 is consistent with C15H26O.
polysantol.vp_note: Codebase: 0.01 (ingredient_intelligence) vs 0.003 (P.yaml). P.yaml value is more plausible for a heavy sandalwood molecule. Use 0.003 Pa.
polysantol.odt_note: Codebase: 0.01 ppb (odor_thresholds) vs 1.5 ppb (P.yaml). Perplexity: 0.02 ppt = 0.00000002 ppm. The 0.01 ppb air value is plausible for an ultra-potent sandalwood. Use 0.01 ppb air, 0.5 ppm ethanol.
polysantol.odor_profile: Creamy sandalwood, ultra-tenacious, floral-woody. Firmenich captive.
polysantol.ifra_note: IFRA Category 4 limit 1.1% in finished product.
polysantol.note: 8x more effective in wash retention than comparable sandalwood synthetics.

tobacco-ftec.odt_note: Estimated from tobacco absolute literature. No authoritative ODT for this specific blend.
tobacco-ftec.odor_profile: Warm sweet woody smoky, tobacco leaf, dried fruit, hay.
tobacco-ftec.note: Proprietary FTEC blend. All physical properties are estimates.

tobacco-fleuressence.odor_profile: Warm sweet woody smoky, tobacco, hay, slightly animalic. Pre-blended.
tobacco-fleuressence.note: Proprietary Fleuressence blend. All physical properties are estimates.

vetikon.mw_note: Codebase: 222.37. PubChem search returned MW 176.25 for CID 81898 which may be a different compound. Vetikon (CAS 7403-42-1) is likely vetiver-related. Use 222.37 from codebase as it's consistent with sesquiterpene alcohol structure.
vetikon.odt_note: Estimated from vetiver-type materials (vetiver ODT is ~5 ppb air). No authoritative source found for this specific material.
vetikon.odor_profile: Woody, vetiver-type, dry, earthy, slightly green. Vetiver derivative.
vetikon.note: CAS 7403-42-1. Limited public data. Vetiver-derived sesquiterpenoid.

ylang-ylang-eo.mw_note: Representative. Natural oil varies by distillation fraction. Extra grade = first fraction, richest in linalool and esters.
ylang-ylang-eo.vp_note: Estimated from Ylang Comoros Complete data in codebase.
ylang-ylang-eo.odt_note: Use Ylang Comoros Complete ODT as reference. Extra grade is similar composition.
ylang-ylang-eo.odor_profile: Rich sweet floral, narcotic, creamy, banana-like, jasmine-tropical, warm spicy.
ylang-ylang-eo.allergen_note: Contains linalool, geraniol, benzyl benzoate, benzyl salicylate, eugenol, farnesol, benzyl acetate - all EU allergens.

pcme.vp_note: Codebase: 0.3 Pa (ingredient_intelligence). Literature VP is much higher (~40 Pa). Codebase value is wrong.
pcme.odt_note: Estimated from cresol-family literature. No codebase ODT data. p-Cresyl methyl ether has a low threshold.
pcme.odor_profile: Animalic narcissus, hyacinth, floral-phenolic, slightly medicinal, narcotic.
pcme.allergen_note: Listed as potential sensitizer. Use at 10% dilution.
